edbDesc: A method used to alter the physical, and sometimes chemical, properties of a material through the use of heating or chilling, normally to extreme temperatures, to achieve a desired result such as hardening or softening of a material. Heat treatment techniques include annealing, case hardening, precipitation strengthening, tempering and quenching.
title: Heat Treatment
pickWhy: A family of industrial processes (hardening, tempering, annealing), not a single nameable effect.
